def alg(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=min(cnt, key=lambda c: cnt[c])
    # split active rows
    active=[any(grid[r][c]==fg for c in range(w)) for r in range(h)]
    groups=[]; r=0
    while r<h:
        if not active[r]: r+=1; continue
        s=r
        while r<h and active[r]:r+=1
        groups.append([(rr-s,c) for rr in range(s,r) for c in range(w) if grid[rr][c]==fg])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(len(groups)):
      for j in range(i+1,len(groups)):
        A,B=groups[i],groups[j]
        if max((y for y,x in A),default=-1)!=max((y for y,x in B),default=-2):continue
        best=None
        # consider directed source i->j dx and j->i -dx for equivalent alignment
        for dx in range(-w+1,w):
          for si,sj,dd in [(i,j,dx),(j,i,-dx)]:
            S=groups[si]; T=groups[sj]
            sh={(y,x+dd) for y,x in S if 0<=x+dd<w}
            tt=set(T); ov=len(sh&tt)
            key=(ov,len(sh),-abs(dd),-si) # overlap, coverage, modest shift; prefer earlier source tie
            if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,si,sj,dd,sh-tt)
        if best:
          _,si,sj,dd,miss=best
          # map relative target rows to global target start
          starts=[]
          r=0
          while r<h:
            if not active[r]:r+=1;continue
            s=r
            while r<h and active[r]:r+=1
            starts.append(s)
          for y,x in miss:
            out[starts[sj]+y][x]=1
    return out
